params.description: Squeeze release plus 20-bar breakout inside a bullish EMA200 regime, designed to enter expansion after compression.

SwitchingOverlay.description: 100% BTC when overlay is long, otherwise cash

RiskReductionOverlay.description: 35% BTC core plus 65% overlay sleeve, for 35%-100% total exposure

summary_points: SwitchingOverlay cuts max drawdown from -77.04% to -34.49%, but gives up too much absolute return to be the preferred integration.
AddOnOverlay keeps return close to B&H while improving Sharpe by +0.041 and Calmar by +0.068.
RiskReductionOverlay delivers the largest drawdown improvement among the always-invested variants, but sacrifices much more absolute return than AddOnOverlay.
The overlay is materially more valuable as a portfolio module than as an attempted standalone BTC buy-and-hold replacement.

recommendation.positioning_call: The line is best used as an add-on overlay.
recommendation.positioning_detail: As a portfolio building block, the overlay works best as a trend add-on: it is the only tested integration that improved total return, CAGR, Sharpe, Calmar, and max drawdown versus pure BTC buy-and-hold at the same time. RiskReductionOverlay remains the defensive alternative when drawdown reduction is the first priority.
recommendation.single_choice: Choose AddOnOverlay if only one integration mode is deployed.
recommendation.paper_live_rehearsal: YES, AddOnOverlay is strong enough to justify paper/live rehearsal as an overlay sleeve.
